doc.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
doc.interviewee: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack")

title: The Lindsay family
summary: They recall John Lindsay's family, the sister Mamie who traveled with them, and Herbert Lindsay, who may still be in Chicago.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, we've had no reason or occasion to bring up all those names, and so you do forget. Yeah, certainly. But when we hear him again, remember, well, I used to know him. Sure, sure.
Yes. And, Burbeth. Their father. Burbeth. Yeah. They lived right around the corner. Mm-hmm. Mamie, the sister, she went away with us. Yeah.
Mamie, the children did. Went to, in Memphis. She stopped in Memphis, didn't you? Was it Memphis? It was.
It wasn't, but she'd come back there. She stopped there.

Can you tell me, um, if, uh, Johnny Lindsay, I know his dad died 1951, I believe, up here, when I was here, I knew him, but his brother, somebody told me he had a brother still living here. Do you know?
Is he still here? He's here somewhere. He was on South Parkway the last time I heard from him. I saw him. Buzzy saw him, my brother. Yeah. You see, my brother, he knows, see everybody from home.
I wish I could find him sometime and interview him. I won't be able to do this trip, I suppose, but next trip, maybe.
